gen-gf-grandstander-gf-mukta-mahee: Expressive and flat-lined, Grandstander shouts in constant-width strokes, while Mukta Mahee follows with chunky, tall lowercase that feels welcoming. Long stretches of text settle into a clean, approachable rhythm in this sans-serif.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-mukta-malar: Mukta Malar reads neutrally, with compressed ascenders that keep its lines low and tidy. Grandstander then adds bold, expressive strokes of constant width, with no vertical emphasis at all.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-mukta-vaani: Bold lettering with a level beat: Grandstander's strokes carry no accents of weight at all. And Mukta Vaani, a plain sans with a high-waisted lowercase, keeps long paragraphs moving smoothly.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-narnoor: Narnoor keeps its ascenders short above big bowls, which gives text a businesslike, level look. Narnoor sits quietly under Grandstander's bold, constant-width headings, letting them do all the shouting.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-display: Grandstander lays down bold, constant-width strokes with no hairline-to-stem shift. Noto Sans Display, a sans-serif whose big, tall middle zone fills every word, makes an approachable counterweight beneath it.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-play: Play has little height difference between its cases and a faint weight shift between upstrokes and downstrokes. Play then sits beside Grandstander's wirelike, single-thickness strokes, adding a gentle change where its bowls curve.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-port-lligat-sans: Port Lligat Sans reads tightly packed, its bowls left open on one side. Grandstander, bent like a single length of wire, is best at bold, expressive display lettering, while the sans is best at minimal, modern text.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-ramabhadra: Loud, flat lettering: Grandstander keeps every stroke free of brush-style pressure swells, while Ramabhadra's prominent x-height anchors the text. Long paragraphs in the sans-serif move along clean and steady.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-rambla: Grandstander draws bold, expressive letters with no stroke modulation at all. And Rambla's small letters, standing almost as tall as capitals, are the most distinctive thing about this sans-serif body.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-recursive: Recursive reads in modern, approachable lines, with a tall mean line and uniform thickness in every direction. And beside Grandstander's bold headings, this plain sans carries a full page of text without tiring the eye.
